title: Property Maintenance evidence stages corrected
details: Multi-part Property Maintenance evidence sentences are now split into one evidence stage per item instead of generic invented stages
Repair tiles now uses four stages: Tiling repair, Setting out, Preparation and Cutting
Plaster repairs now follows the three items in its instruction: Plaster defect, Preparation and Finished repair
Flooring, drainage, doors and windows, masonry, roofing, fencing and groundwork now follow the same sentence-to-stage rule
Every stage offers one photo or video, with the existing photo explanation and guided-video flow retained
Legacy capture controls are fully hidden while a staged task is open so duplicate camera buttons cannot appear
summary: Evia v134 makes Property Maintenance evidence stages match the task wording exactly.
changes: Removed invented generic repair stages from ST0171
Split each relevant evidence sentence into its actual evidence items
Kept single-item Property Maintenance tasks as single evidence captures
Stopped legacy capture controls leaking through the staged evidence screen
Moved the offline shell to v134
